user_input: Refactor the Flutter project `campus_notif_clean_architecture` in this repository to Feature-First Clean Architecture with Presentation, Domain, and Data layers; enforce practical SOLID (SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP); separate Entity, Model, Repository contracts/implementations, Use Cases, and Riverpod DI. Preserve existing Login, Authentication, Firebase Messaging, and Notification behavior. Inspect actual repo and README first, use current conventions and dependencies where possible. Make and verify complete implementation changes (not a plan), run relevant formatting/analyze/tests/build validation available. Do not disturb unrelated worktree changes. Since Dart/Flutter changes are made, arrange/execute required Flutter hot restart/reload if available via tools; report exact limits if no running app. Return concise changed files, architecture summary, and validation.
title: Flutter Feature-First Clean Architecture Refactor

assessment_snapshot.intro: The supplied project facts describe a single-module Flutter/Dart mobile application with:
bullets: 1,358 non-blank Dart LOC across 14 Dart files; the application README and source are to be inspected by downstream implementation work, not by this clarification gate
Login/authentication, Firebase Messaging, and notifications named as behavior to preserve
An in-place, same-stack architecture refactor with no module grouping required

proposed_outcome: Refactor the existing Flutter app in place into feature-first Presentation, Domain, and Data layers, with entities/models, repository contracts and implementations, use cases, and Riverpod dependency injection; preserve login, authentication, messaging, and notification behavior and verify the result using the available Flutter validation and runtime tools.
